headlines.title: Growth in China’s factory-gate prices accelerates, but consumer inflation subdued
headlines.summary:
Growth in Chinese factory-gate prices continued to accelerate last month, while consumer price growth remained subdued despite Beijing’s efforts to shore up domestic demand and support the economy in meeting its annual growth target.
The producer price index (PPI) rose 5 per cent year on year in September, the highest rate since mid-2022, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Wednesday. It rose by 3.8 per cent in August.
The reading beat a projection of 4.3 per cent...
headlines.title_zh: 中国工业生产者出厂价格涨幅加快，但消费者通胀低迷
headlines.summary_zh:
中国出厂价格上月继续加速上涨，而尽管北京方面努力提振国内需求并支持经济实现年度增长目标，消费者价格涨幅仍保持低迷。
数据显示，9月份生产者价格指数（PPI）同比上涨5%，为2022年年中以来的最高水平。

headlines.title: 港交所：接受中国国债作为衍生产品结算所非现金抵押品
headlines.summary: 10月16日，香港交易所宣布，自2026年11月2日起，中国国债将获接纳为香港期货结算有限公司及香港联合交易所期权结算所履行保证金要求的合资格非现金抵押品，有关规则修订已获香港证券及期货事务监察委员会批准。获接纳的债券包括，由中华人民共和国财政部发行，并主要面向国际市场发行的财政部债券；在中国银行间债券市场交易，并由中华人民共和国财政部或政策性银行发行的债券通债券。（中证金牛座）

headlines.title_en: HKEX: Accepts Chinese government bonds as non-cash collateral for the derivatives clearing house
headlines.summary_en: On October 16, Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing announced that, starting from November 2, 2026, Chinese government bonds will be accepted as eligible non-cash collateral for margin requirements of HKFE Clearing Corporation Limited and The SEHK Options Clearing House Limited, and the relevant rule amendments have been approved by the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission. Accepted bonds include Ministry of Finance bonds issued by the Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China and mainly offered to the international market; and Bond Connect bonds traded in China's interbank bond market and issued by the Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China or policy banks. (Zhongzheng Jinniu Zuo)

headlines.title: ST佳缘：2026年收到证监会处罚决定并被罚600万元
headlines.summary: ST佳缘公告，2026年10月16日，公司收到中国证监会《行政处罚决定书》。因信息披露违法违规，公司被责令改正、给予警告并处以600万元罚款；王进、朱伟华、柳絮、尹明君分别被罚300万元、200万元、200万元、150万元。处罚认定公司《招股说明书》中2019年、2020年财务数据及2021年和2022年年度报告内容存在虚假记载，公司判断相关行为触及股票交易被实施其他风险警示情形。

headlines.title_en: ST Jiayuan: Received CSRC penalty decision in 2026 and was fined 6 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: ST Jiayuan announced that on October 16, 2026, the company received an Administrative Penalty Decision from the CSRC. For information disclosure violations, the company was ordered to rectify, given a warning, and fined 6 million yuan; Wang Jin, Zhu Weihua, Liu Xu, and Yin Mingjun were fined 3 million yuan, 2 million yuan, 2 million yuan, and 1.5 million yuan, respectively. The penalty found that the company's 2019 and 2020 financial data in its prospectus and the contents of its 2021 and 2022 annual reports contained false records, and the company determined that the relevant conduct triggered the circumstances for other risk warnings on its stock trading.

headlines.title: 国常会：要持续规范平台经济领域价格竞争行为 引导企业不断提升产品和服务价值
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月16日讯，李强主持召开国务院常务会议，会议讨论并原则通过《中华人民共和国价格法（修正草案）》，决定将草案提请全国人大常委会审议。会议指出，此次修正适应新形势新变化，进一步健全了价格治理机制，完善了政府定价程序，明确了不正当价格行为认定标准和法律责任。要依法依规治理低价无序竞争，健全行业成本调查、制止低价倾销等配套规则，加强价格执法监管。要持续规范平台经济领域价格竞争行为，引导企业不断提升产品和服务价值，营造公平有序市场环境。

headlines.title_en: State Council executive meeting: It is necessary to continuously regulate price competition in the platform economy and guide enterprises to continuously enhance the value of their products and services
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 16 - Li Qiang presided over a State Council executive meeting. The meeting discussed and approved in principle the Price Law of the People's Republic of China (Amendment Draft) and decided to submit the draft to the NPC Standing Committee for deliberation. The meeting noted that this amendment adapts to new situations and changes, further improves the price governance mechanism, refines government pricing procedures, and clarifies the criteria for identifying improper pricing behavior and legal liabilities. It is necessary to govern low-price disorderly competition in accordance with laws and regulations, improve supporting rules such as industry cost investigations and prohibition of below-cost dumping, and strengthen price law enforcement and supervision. It is necessary to continuously regulate price competition behavior in the platform economy, guide enterprises to continually enhance the value of products and services, and foster a fair and orderly market environment.

headlines.title: 国常会讨论并原则通过《中华人民共和国教师法（修订草案）》
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月16日讯，李强主持召开国务院常务会议，会议讨论并原则通过《中华人民共和国教师法（修订草案）》，决定将草案提请全国人大常委会审议。会议指出，教师是立教之本、兴教之源，要切实强化教师待遇权益保障，减轻教师非教育教学任务负担，加强对教师的社会公共服务，维护好教师职业尊严和合法权益。要培养造就高素质专业化教师队伍，健全教师教育体系，提高教书育人能力，强化师德师风建设，在全社会营造尊师重教的良好氛围。

headlines.title_en: The State Council executive meeting discussed and in principle approved the Teachers Law of the People's Republic of China (Revised Draft)
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 16 - Li Qiang presided over a State Council executive meeting. The meeting discussed and approved in principle the Teachers Law of the People's Republic of China (Revision Draft) and decided to submit the draft to the NPC Standing Committee for deliberation. The meeting noted that teachers are the foundation of education and the source of its prosperity, and that it is necessary to effectively strengthen safeguards for teachers' compensation and rights, reduce the burden of non-teaching tasks on teachers, enhance social and public services for teachers, and protect teachers' professional dignity and lawful rights and interests. It is necessary to cultivate a high-quality professional teaching workforce, improve the teacher education system, enhance teaching and educating capabilities, strengthen teacher ethics and conduct, and create a good atmosphere of respecting teachers and valuing education throughout society.

headlines.title: 国常会：要突出赋能应用 让人工智能技术更好转化为现实生产力
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月16日讯，李强主持召开国务院常务会议，会议指出，人工智能是影响未来发展的关键变量，要从我国产业体系完备、应用场景丰富、工程化能力强等实际出发，注重以落地应用牵引技术创新，不断深化拓展“人工智能+”行动。要夯实发展底座，加强技术攻关和算法创新促进算电协同，增加高质量数据供给，着力补短板、锻长板。要突出赋能应用，以实体经济为重点强化供需衔接，鼓励联合研发，推进中试验证，加大场景培育力度，让人工智能技术更好转化为现实生产力。要统筹发展和安全，因业分级分类施策，加强风险研判评估，守牢人工智能安全底线。

headlines.title_en: State Council executive meeting: It is necessary to highlight empowerment applications so that AI technology can be better transformed into real productivity
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 16 - Li Qiang presided over a State Council executive meeting. The meeting noted that artificial intelligence is a key variable affecting future development, and that starting from China's realities of a complete industrial system, rich application scenarios, and strong engineering capabilities, it is necessary to focus on driving technological innovation through implemented applications and continuously deepen and expand the "AI+" initiative. It is necessary to consolidate the development foundation, strengthen technological breakthroughs and algorithm innovation to promote computing-power coordination, increase the supply of high-quality data, and focus on shoring up weaknesses and forging strengths. It is necessary to highlight enabling applications, strengthen supply-demand alignment with the real economy as the focus, encourage joint research and development, advance pilot testing, and increase efforts to cultivate scenarios so that AI technology can be better transformed into real productivity. It is necessary to coordinate development and security, implement industry-specific tiered and categorized measures, strengthen risk assessment and evaluation, and firmly uphold the bottom line of AI security.

headlines.title_en: BofA strategists expect risk aversion to intensify, with the Federal Reserve and midterm elections in focus
headlines.summary_en: Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett said that as investors seek to avoid rising interest rates and the volatility brought by U.S. midterm elections and AI-themed trades, risk-averse sentiment is expected to dominate markets in the coming weeks. Hartnett said in a report that the "extremely bullish sentiment" of this summer has ended. Global bonds have been broadly sold off, pushing inflation-adjusted real yields to 3%, while rising energy prices and sticky inflation have also intensified investor concerns. "Given real yields at 3%, we continue to favor risk aversion over the next 3 to 4 weeks," Hartnett said. His team expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates in October to "restore credibility," given that inflation has exceeded central bank targets for more than five consecutive years. Hartnett also believes Democrats will achieve a 'wave'

headlines.title_en: China Minsheng Bank: Successfully issued 10 billion yuan in financial bonds

headlines.title_en: Xingfu Electronic: Plans a private placement to raise no more than RMB 260 million for a 40,000-ton-per-year electronic-grade phosphoric acid project
headlines.summary_en: Xingfu Electronic announced that the company plans to issue A-shares to specific targets through a simplified procedure, with total funds raised not exceeding RMB 260 million and no more than 35 issuance targets. After deducting issuance expenses, the raised funds are intended for a 40,000-ton-per-year electronic-grade phosphoric acid project. headlines.title_en: CICC: The share-swap absorption merger of Dongxing Securities and Xinda Securities is about to be implemented
headlines.summary_en: CICC announced that its share-swap absorption merger of Dongxing Securities and Xinda Securities has received CSRC approval, and the shares of Dongxing Securities and Xinda Securities will be delisted from October 19, 2026. The record date for the implementation of this A-share share swap is October 16, 2026; the A-share swap ratio for Dongxing Securities is 1:0.4376, and the A-share swap ratio for Xinda Securities is 1:0.5210. After the merger is completed, Dongxing Securities and Xinda Securities will have their legal person status canceled, and all their assets, liabilities, and other matters will be assumed by CICC. The newly added A-shares of CICC will apply for listing and trading on the main board of the SSE.

headlines.title: 香港证监会欢迎香港交易所拟在香港股票市场实施T+1结算周期
headlines.summary: 香港证监会市场监察部执行董事梁仲贤先生表示：“结算周期过渡至T+1乃维持香港作为国际金融中心的竞争力，以及确保与全球市场发展接轨的重要一步。我们欢迎香港交易所发表谘询总结，及采取以市场准备情况为依据的实施方式。本会呼吁业界参与者及早展开准备工作，评估有关转变对其系统、流程及营运安排的影响，并与交易对手及服务供应商紧密合作，以确保过渡工作顺利有序。”（香港证监会）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC welcomes HKEX's plan to implement a T+1 settlement cycle in the Hong Kong stock market
headlines.summary_en: Mr. Leung Chung-yin, Executive Director of the Market Supervision Department of the Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong, said: "The transition of the settlement cycle to T+1 is an important step in maintaining Hong Kong's competitiveness as an international financial center and ensuring alignment with global market developments. We welcome the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's publication of the consultation conclusions and its adoption of an implementation approach based on market readiness. The Commission calls on industry participants to begin preparatory work as early as possible, assess the impact of the change on their systems, processes and operational arrangements, and work closely with counterparties and service providers to ensure a smooth and orderly transition." (Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong)
